cards.text: Jesus is on the Mount of Olives with Peter, James, John and Andrew, who asked Him privately when the temple would be thrown down (Mark 13:2-4). He's been warning them about false Christs and about days of tribulation unseen since God made the world (Mark 13:19-22). Now He says that after that tribulation, the sun will go dark and the moon won't give its light.

cards.question: With the sun and moon going dark, what does Jesus say will happen to the stars?

answers.text: They will fall from the sky
They will stay right where they are

cards.question: Jesus says the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

cards.text: Then Jesus says that at that time, they will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds. Son of Man is the name Jesus uses for Himself (Mark 2:10).

cards.question: After the sun, moon and stars are shaken, how does Jesus say the Son of Man will come in the clouds?

cards.text: Friend, it took ONE angel to call me out of ONE junk drawer. Here the Son of Man sends out the angels, plural, to the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven, all for His elect.

cards.question: The Son of Man sends out the angels to ___ His elect.

cards.text: Then Jesus gives them a lesson from the fig tree: its branches get tender and sprout leaves. Friend, I couldn't grow a fig tree if you taped the instructions to my hat, but even I know what new leaves mean.

cards.question: As soon as the fig branches sprout leaves, you know that ___ is near.

cards.text: Then Jesus turns the lesson from the tree to the things He's been telling them about.

cards.question: When the disciples see these things happening, what does Jesus say they should know?

answers.text: He is near right at the door
They still have plenty of time

cards.question: The fig tree lesson teaches the disciples to read the signs the way people read the seasons.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, “Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.”
Next Jesus sets His words right next to heaven and earth. Things wear out, friend, and my blurry old edges could tell you ALL about it.

cards.question: Heaven and earth will pass away. What does Jesus say about His words?

cards.text: Then Jesus says no one knows about that day or hour. Not the angels in heaven, and not even the Son.

cards.question: If not the angels in heaven and not the Son, who does Jesus say knows about that day or hour?
Since no one knows when the appointed time will come, what does Jesus tell His disciples to do?

answers.text: Be on guard and stay alert
Wait for a prophet to tell them

cards.text: Then Jesus paints a picture: a man going on a journey leaves his house. And he doesn't leave his servants with nothing to do.

cards.question: In Jesus' picture of the man going on a journey, what does the man put each servant in charge of?
The man also tells the servant at the door, the doorkeeper, to keep ___.

cards.text: Jesus says keep watch, because you don't know when the master of the house will return: evening, midnight, when the rooster crows, or morning. It's like waiting on a delivery with no tracking, and the SECOND you hop in the shower, the doorbell rings.

cards.question: If the master of the house arrives without notice, Jesus warns he may find you ___.
Jesus has been talking privately with Peter, James, John and Andrew. He says His call to keep watch is only for the four of them.

cards.text: What He says to them, He says to everyone: “Keep watch!” The snooze button has beaten stronger folks than me, friend, so in my bakery it's ovens warm, apron on, eyes OPEN.
